card.line: Carchemish was a city on the Euphrates River where Egypt's army marched to fight, and where Babylon later defeated Pharaoh Neco's army.

moments.title: Neco marches to Carchemish
moments.text: Neco king of Egypt marched up to fight at Carchemish by the Euphrates. Josiah went out to confront him, even though Neco said God had told him to hurry.

moments.title: Carchemish named by Assyria's king
moments.text: The king of Assyria boasted that he had conquered cities like Carchemish. God said He would punish the king for his proud heart.

moments.title: Egypt defeated at Carchemish
moments.text: The word of the LORD came to Jeremiah about Pharaoh Neco's army. Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon defeated it at Carchemish on the Euphrates River.
